summary: Astro site config: sets canonical `site` to https://coldstartmcp.dev (consumed by @astrojs/sitemap for absolute URLs) and registers the @astrojs/sitemap + @astrojs/tailwind integrations. The sitemap is generated at build time from the site's routes — no hand-maintained sitemap file. It now passes a serialize() hook that stamps each URL's <lastmod> from its source file's last git commit date: sourceFileForRoute() maps a route back to src/pages/*.astro (or src/content/blog/<slug>.md for posts), and lastCommitDate() shells out to git log. historyUsable is computed ONCE at module load via `git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository` — this guard exists because git log does not fail in a shallow clone, it returns that clone's single commit date for every file, which would stamp all 16 URLs with the same wrong timestamp.
